marks.gloss_en: earthenware should be impure from its outer side too
all vessels, not impure from their airspace, are impure from their outer side; an earthenware vessel, impure from its airspace, should surely be impure from its outer side
'every open vessel with no sealed cover' -- with a cover it is pure, so not via the outer side
'and every open vessel with no sealed cover on it': the vessel whose impurity is by its opening is earthenware; with a sealed cover it is pure
it is when there is no sealed cover on it that it is impure; when there is a sealed cover on it, it is pure
all other vessels should be impure from their airspace too
an earthenware vessel, not impure from its outer side, is impure from its airspace; all vessels, impure from their outer side, should surely be impure from their airspace
'tokho' -- the airspace of THIS vessel, not of another
'tokho' -- the tokho of this one, and not the tokho of another
other vessels should not be impure from their outer side either

an earthenware vessel, impure from its airspace, is not impure from its outer side; all vessels, not impure from their airspace, should surely not be impure from their outer side, only from within and by contact
'IT is impure' -- this one alone is pure when covered; all other vessels are impure either way
'...it is impure': THIS one, with a sealed cover, is pure; all other vessels become impure covered or not
but all [other] vessels, whether there is a sealed cover on them or not, become impure
food in the airspace of an inner vessel inside an impure earthenware vessel stays pure ('tokho' and not 'tokh tokho'), even if the inner vessel is a rinsable vessel
that which is pure in wooden vessels is impure in metal vessels
unfinished wooden vessels are susceptible to impurity
a wooden vessel still awaiting smoothing, inlay, planing, grooving, or tuna-skin polish, or lacking a base, rim, or handle, is susceptible
even one who hollowed a three-log capacity in a block intended for a one-kav vessel: the receptacle is incomplete, so it is not susceptible
